representation.train_feature_gate: probe has >=95% finite values separately in training tumors and training normals
representation.scaling: training-fold mean and sample SD only; zero/nonfinite SD removed
representation.pc1: leading principal component fit on training samples only
representation.orientation: multiply PC1 by -1 if training tumor mean score is below training normal mean score

primary.endpoint: number of held-out pairs with tumor PC1 score > matched normal PC1 score
primary.support_rule: one-sided exact p <= 0.05 and concordant pairs > 16

comparator.endpoint: training-feature global mean beta score with orientation learned in training fold
comparator.role: simple comparator; no ADDS claim unless PC1 beats it under a separately reported paired discordance test

claim_ceiling: exploratory external tissue-state discrimination; not clinical diagnostic utility, not a deployable biomarker, and not an H1 patient-level score
